Method.name: OnProcessInput
Method.Implementation:
Set tStat = $$$OK $$$LOGINFO("In OnProcessInput") // get an instance of JMSGateway and connect to JMSGateway Super Server Set jmsgateway=##class(EnsLib.JavaGateway.JavaGateway).%New() Set classPath=##class(%ListOfDataTypes).%New() $$$LOGINFO("To connect")
Do classPath.Insert(..JMSJarPath) $$$LOGINFO("JMS Call Path added: " _ ..JMSJarPath) Set status=jmsgateway.%Connect(..JavaGWHost,..JavaGWPort,$NAMESPACE,5,classPath) If 'status { set tStat = $$$ISERR(status) Quit tStat } set topicConnection = "" set topicSubscriber = "" try { $$$LOGINFO("Connected to Java Gateway " _ ..JavaGWHost _ ":" _ ..JavaGWPort) set tcf = ##class(com.seebeyond.jms.client.STCTopicConnectionFactory).%New(jmsgateway, ..JMSHost, ..JMSPort) set topicConnection = tcf.createTopicConnection() do topicConnection.stop()
$$$LOGINFO("Connected to JMS: " _ ..JMSHost _ ":" _ ..JMSPort) set topicSession = topicConnection.createTopicSession(1, 1) // "true","Session.AUTO_ACKNOWLEDGE")
set topic = topicSession.createTopic(..TopicName) $$$LOGINFO("Created sub: " _ ..TopicName)
set topicSubscriber = topicSession.createDurableSubscriber(topic, "EnsembleTestDemo") $$$LOGINFO("createSubscriber") do topicConnection.start()
$$$LOGINFO("receive") set message=topicSubscriber.receive() if message.%IsA("javax.jms.TextMessage") { $$$LOGINFO("Got a TextMessage: " _ message.message.getText()) Set tSC = ..SendRequestAsync(..TargetConfigNames,message.getText()) $$$LOGINFO("SendRequestAsync to " _ ..TargetConfigNames _ "Status: " _ tSc) } elseif message.%IsA("javax.jms.BytesMessage") { set arrLen = 500 set comMsg = "" $$$LOGINFO("javax.jms.BytesMessage") Set readStream=##class(%GlobalBinaryStream).%New() // reserve a number of bytes since we are passing the stream by reference
For i=1:1:arrLen Do readStream.Write("0") do { set bytesRead = message.readBytes(.readStream, arrLen) set msgText = readStream.Read(bytesRead) set comMsg = comMsg _ msgText // $$$LOGINFO( "byte msg. length " _ bytesRead ) } while (bytesRead = arrLen) $$$LOGINFO("Create stream") set strData=##class(%Stream.GlobalCharacter).%New() $$$LOGINFO("Write to stream") set wStat = strData.Write(comMsg) $$$LOGINFO("stream write: " _ comMsg _ ", stat: " _ wStat)
Set pInput=$classmethod(..#CONTAINERCLASS,"%New",strData) $$$LOGINFO("Created stream container")
For iTarget=1:1:$L(..TargetConfigNames, ",") { Set tOneTarget=$ZStrip($P(..TargetConfigNames,",",iTarget),"<>W") Continue:""=tOneTarget
$$$LOGINFO("Send msg to " _ tOneTarget) Set tSC1=..SendRequestAsync(tOneTarget,pInput) Set:$$$ISERR(tSC1) tSC=$$$ADDSC(tSC,tSC1) }
} $$$LOGINFO("Commit and close") Do topicSession.commit() Do topicSubscriber.close()
Do topicConnection.stop() Do topicConnection.close() Do jmsgateway.%Disconnect()
} catch err { if (topicConnection '= "") { Do topicConnection.stop() Do topicConnection.close() } if (topicSubscriber '= "") { Do topicSubscriber.close() }
if $GET(%objlasterror) '= "" { set errMsg = $System.Status.GetErrorText(%objlasterror) } else { set errMsg = "No obj" } $$$LOGERROR("Exception: Name: " _ err.Name _ " / Location:" _ err.Location _ " / Data: " _err.Data _ " / Details: " _ errMsg) Do jmsgateway.%Disconnect() set tStat = $$$ERROR($$$GeneralError, "Exception: Name: " _ err.Name) } $$$LOGINFO("Quit") Quit tStat
